title: Unoverse pipeline
description: pipeline.yaml: the source side of ingestion (docs/unoverse/data/pipelines/README.md layer 1). The face as a node's node.yaml, then two keys of its own: collect, the nodes that fetch in order, and make, the objects made in order. Nothing else: no row, no yields (gone 2026-09-10), no HTTP, no credentials, no hosts.

whenToUse.description: When to point this pipeline at a source, in the person's words; shown on the Import screen.

name.description: A later step and every make entry read this step's outputs as collect.<name>.<output>.

node.description: The node this step runs, by type. It carries its own credential, found by type in the org's store.

config.description: The node's config, with {{ config.* }} and {{ collect.<earlier>.* }} references.

make.description: What is made, in order (docs/unoverse/data/pipelines/README.md, make). An entry with each makes objects from each item's row; an entry without each makes objects once per pack, from the rows made per item.

each.description: A list over collect ({{ collect.<step>.<list> }}): one row per item.

sourceUrl.description: The row's address, over item, when the collect node does not give one (item.address).

sourceId.description: The row's identity, over item, when the collect node does not give one (item.universalId).

content.description: What the row carries instead of the item as listed, each value over item, index, config and collect.

additionalProperties.description: An object made, keyed by its name.

cardinality.description: How many one row (or one pack) makes.

any.description: The item MAY be one; the model says.

per.description: Written once the document's pages are kept, one read per page, instead of in the document's first read (page-store.md: no sections).

read.description: With per: page, the node that reads the pages for this object: handed the chunks that name it, with a template made from its input props (pipelines README, Or read by a node).

chunks.description: How many of the document's chunks it is handed: the best few by the object's words (default 4), or all of them.

cacheable.description: This read's answers may be reused, remembered under the version the called deployment reports at its /ready; a deployment that reports none is never remembered (pipelines README, A read may be remembered).

tables.description: Read from the document's tables too: a table's labels matched to the object's props by their wordings, a matched cell's value copied as printed (pipelines/tables.md).

whose.description: The node that says which of the document's rows a table is about, when the document is linked to more than one.

subject.description: The object is what the document is about: a label | value table fills the row of this kind the document is linked to.

labels.description: The node that proposes a field for a table label no rule matched (column matching step 4): asked once per org, one call per document; a person approves it in Review. Absent: the step is off.

allocations.description: The object's line an allocation table draws to each fund it holds, carrying the weight (pipelines/tables.md 3c).

boards.description: The object's lines a board list may draw, each to whose board it is (the line whose kind the organisation is), carrying the role (pipelines/tables.md 3d).

parts.description: Rows of their own taken from the object's read, no model call: table: "{{ detail.tables }}".

index.description: The object's rows, with their parts, are in the pack's index. index: {}

where.description: Made once per pack: which rows it is made from, per field the values allowed.
